name: rules-rtdb-r54-regex-alternation-runtime
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r54-regex-alternation-runtime" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). the anchor rewrite production applies has no group around the pattern, so an unanchored or half-anchored top-level alternation may not mean "contains either side" as it does in JavaScript; no runtime case has observed it.
